context.passage:
Nita Mittal (9:08 A.M.)
Hi, Mitch. I've boarded the plane, but the captain just
announced that we're waiting for connecting passengers, so
we'll be delayed. Can you let the car service know?
Mitch Richards (9:12 A.M.)
Of course. Tell me when you're about to take off. I'll adjust
your pickup time as needed.
Nita Mittal (9:15 A.M.)
Thanks. And thanks also for e-mailing the safety handbook.
Ned Grant needs to have copies printed by Friday.
Mitch Richards (9:17 A.M.)
No problem.
Nita Mittal (9:50 A.M.)
I'm still on the ground. I might not make my connection in
Dallas.
Oca
Mitch Richards (9:55 A.M.)
Don't worry. We'll deal with it.
Nita Mittal (10:10 A.M.)
It looks like we'll be off in a few minutes. It will be close.
Mitch Richards (10:11 A.M.)
OK. I hope it works out!
